title: guideline resource content
description: The JSON text of guideline://G<n>. It cites the guideline: number, version, the one-line rule and the hub link (C39). It never copies the guideline text or the playbook.

version.description: Two parts: the first changes the rule, the second only the wording.

hubUrl.description: The canonical text on the public hub. Null until the hub location is set.

chapter.description: The playbook chapter it belongs to.

isActive.description: False for a retired number, such as G10 and G11 in the public list version 1.0. Numbers are never reused.

isAdopted.description: False when the client chose not to adopt it.

localUrl.description: The client's own page for it.

configurationSetVersion.description: The configuration set version in force.

examples.rule: Every application names a business owner, a technical owner and a data owner, each with a deputy.
